Does not meet VIGILANCE_I1: the task is not a sustained-attention/vigilance task (e.g., Continuous Performance Task).
Does not meet INITIATION_I1: the task is not an initiation/generation task such as verbal fluency or action generation.

The analysis is a group-level whole-brain task-evoked activation map from a visual oddball task that probes top-down and stimulus-driven attentional control (executive function). The target>standard type contrast reflects task-related activation relevant to cognitive control/attentional processes.

The analysis does not measure initiation (e.g., verbal fluency or action generation) (missing INITIATION_I1) nor an initiation>control contrast (missing INITIATION_I2).

Whole-brain, voxelwise task contrasts from the number bisection task are group-level maps (GLOBAL_I1). The contrasts reflect differences in task demands and recruit executive/cognitive-control processes (GLOBAL_I2). The large-range vs small-range contrast manipulates task difficulty/resource demands within the task, satisfying pooled executive function criteria (POOLED_EXECUTIVE_FUNCTION_I1) and represents a task-related condition contrast (POOLED_EXECUTIVE_FUNCTION_I2).

Excluded: the number bisection task is not a canonical working-memory task (missing WORKING_MEMORY_I1) and the contrasts are not designed as working-memory>control contrasts (missing WORKING_MEMORY_I2).

Excluded: although the paper mentions inhibitory mechanisms, the task is not an established inhibitory-control paradigm (e.g., Go/No-Go) so INHIBITION_I1 is not met; contrasts do not explicitly measure inhibition>control (missing INHIBITION_I2).
Excluded: the task does not measure task-switching or flexibility paradigms (missing COGNITIVE_FLEXIBILITY_I1) and contrasts are not switch>repeat type (missing COGNITIVE_FLEXIBILITY_I2).
Excluded: the number bisection task is not a planning task (missing PLANNING_I1) and contrasts are not planning>control (missing PLANNING_I2).
Excluded: the task is not a sustained-attention/vigilance paradigm (missing VIGILANCE_I1) and contrasts do not index vigilance>control (missing VIGILANCE_I2).
Excluded: the task is not an initiation/generation paradigm (missing INITIATION_I1) and contrasts do not index initiation>control (missing INITIATION_I2).
